customizations.title: Dashboard dispatch limits
customizations.summary: Respect configured total/per-profile in-progress caps, failure limits and default assignee when nudging dashboard dispatch.
customizations.note: Partial port. It does not implement the shared resolver or the upstream proposal's configured max_spawn default.

customizations.title: Worktree skill trust
customizations.summary: Let registered linked worktrees inherit canonical-repository skill trust after Git metadata validation.
customizations.note: Local validation changes differ from the current proposal; review additional upstream trust corrections before retirement.

customizations.title: Profile-owned lifecycle notices
customizations.summary: Use the owning profile's preferences, language, cron store and delivery adapters for shutdown and interrupted-cron notices.
customizations.note: Local port does not include every module extraction or later correction in the current proposal.

customizations.title: Idle compaction timestamp
customizations.summary: Preserve pre-watchdog activity time so the idle-compaction check sees the actual idle gap.
customizations.note: Hand-port adapted to the extracted compaction module.

customizations.title: Stale skill-pin tolerance
customizations.summary: Drop unavailable assignee skill pins at creation and worker launch, recording creation-time drops and warning at launch.
customizations.note: One owner for this behavior: duplicated skill-filter hunks were removed from the token-hygiene artifact.

customizations.title: Compact handoffs and local guidance
customizations.summary: Deliver parent attachments and archived-parent handoffs; reduce duplicated output/history; add compact/minimal views, hard-blocker escalation and local read/card-budget guidance.
customizations.note: Atomic toggle for overlapping changes. Local prompt/card-budget policy has no planned upstream submission; the linked fixes await merges. Default/full output is also trimmed.

customizations.title: Valid project branch slugs
customizations.summary: Strip boundary periods/hyphens, including after truncation, while retaining internal version-number periods.
customizations.note: Backport; retain until the upstream behavior is verified.

customizations.title: Escalating rate-limit respawn backoff
customizations.summary: Hold a card 5m, 15m, 45m, then 2h after consecutive rate-limited runs instead of respawning every 5 minutes forever; relay-pool health gate and board-wide circuit stay inert for non-pool providers.
customizations.note: Whole-PR adoption. 2026-10-02 storm: 1,329 rate-limited respawns across 18 cards in 13 hours.

customizations.title: Superseded check runs never veto PR acceptance
customizations.summary: Judge each required check by its newest run per app. A cancelled run from a superseded workflow suite on the same head no longer rejects completion of a green or merged PR.
customizations.note: Whole-PR adoption; fixes issue NousResearch/hermes-agent#122688. The author closed the PR unmerged after a bot review confirmed the fix. kanban-merged-review-sync is cut on top of this artifact.

customizations.title: Merged review reconciliation
customizations.summary: Reuse persisted PR evidence, prefer the latest execution of each required GitHub check, and reconcile unclaimed merged reviews without holding board locks across GitHub reads.
customizations.note: Re-adapted on top of kanban-superseded-check-runs (its collect_acceptance hunk dropped) and now ships the reconciler module and its tests from the PR. Recheck handoff identity before completion; never bypass acceptance gates.

customizations.title: Independent worktree cleanup
customizations.summary: Clean completed, clean, fully pushed worktrees without waiting on children using independent workspaces; retain shared/scratch workspaces while needed.
customizations.note: Hand-ported onto upstream's terminal-parent sweep guard; retain until upstream behavior and regression tests are verified.

customizations.title: Review completion action
customizations.summary: Expose the existing Complete action for cards in Review so a human reviewer can finish an approved card without reassigning it.
customizations.note: Local dashboard affordance; the backend already permits review-to-done completion.
